set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP: create inventory app script ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
i=0
while :; do
    i=$((i+1))
    logger -t inventory -p local6.info "inventory-app heartbeat #${i}: stock scan cycle complete"
    sleep 10
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh

echo "=== STEP: create inventory systemd service ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory application
After=network.target rsyslog.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "=== STEP: rsyslog forward config ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forward.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
local6.* action(type="omfwd"
                target="10.100.214.10"
                port="514"
                protocol="tcp"
                action.resumeRetryCount="-1"
                queue.type="linkedList"
                queue.filename="inventory_fwd_q"
                queue.saveOnShutdown="on")
EOF
cat /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forward.conf

echo "=== STEP: firewall (outbound is unrestricted by default, verify) ==="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --state
sudo -n firewall-cmd --list-all

echo "=== STEP: enable + restart rsyslog ==="
sudo -n systemctl enable rsyslog
sudo -n systemctl restart rsyslog
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active rsyslog

echo "=== STEP: enable + start inventory service ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory.service
sudo -n systemctl start inventory.service
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory.service

echo "=== STEP: emit an immediate test message ==="
logger -t inventory -p local6.info "inventory-app test message: setup-verification-$(date +%s)"
